description: The news on a stock or coin: whole stories naming it, each with how many outlets and independent owners cover it, newest or most covered first. Use it for "what's the news on NVDA?", "any news about Bitcoin today?" or "what are outlets saying about Tesla?". Give a symbol, ticker, coin, isin or cik; several separated by commas, and match "all" for stories naming every one. Example: symbol "TSLA", sort "sources".

coin.description: Coin codes or CoinMarketCap IDs: BTC,ETH

symbol.description: Any ticker or coin code, comma separated: TSLA,BTC

ticker.description: Tickers, comma separated: NVDA,AAPL or XNAS:NVDA

name: instrument_news
title: Stock and Coin News
